text: dsh-recall（DSH 插件，工具界面）：为 DSH 提供可搜索的本地项目对话摘录。它向 DSH 注册 recall_save、recall_search 和 recall_delete 工具：用户可明确保存一段 user 或 assistant 文本，按关键词查找已保存内容，并按记录版本删除摘录。搜索支持大小写不敏感的多词匹配，也可列出最近保存的记录。数据保存在当前 agent 的工作目录中；主机调用可通过 root 指定目录。适合希望手动保存项目决定并在之后找回的 DSH 用户；不需要 API Key 或外部服务。

dsh-recall is a DSH plugin for saving and searching local project conversation excerpts. Tools save text, search by case-insensitive keywords, list recent records, and delete by revision. Data uses the agent workspace by default; host calls can set a root. No API key or external service is needed.
想把对话里确认过的项目决定存下来，之后能按关键词找回。
有没有办法只搜索我手动保存的项目摘录，而不翻整个会话记录？
How can I save a short conversation excerpt and find it later by keywords?
dsh-recall 的功能「保存项目摘录」：通过 recall_save 工具把调用者提供的 user 或 assistant 文本保存到当前项目，并返回记录信息。可选 sessionId 标注来源；相同内容会返回已有记录。
dsh-recall 的功能「搜索已保存摘录」：通过 recall_search 工具按词语检索本地记录，匹配不区分大小写且要求所有查询词都出现；省略查询可列出最近记录。结果包含文本、角色、来源标记和保存时间。

@lightjunction/dsh-recall README · dsh-recall：DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 plugin. Node >=24; developed and tested locally with Node 26 / TypeScript 5.9.3. Release CI is configured for Node 24; that CI run is separate from local verification.

@lightjunction/dsh-recall README · Install from a GitHub Release：After a release is published, install its built archive into your DSH profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile headless add https://github.com/LIghtJUNction/dsh-recall/releases/download/v0.1.0/lightjunction-dsh-recall-0.1.0.tgz
dsh headless --dump-config
```

@lightjunction/dsh-recall README · Install from a GitHub Release：The release URL is the expected v0.1.0 asset location, not a claim that it has already been published. Use the archive and SHA256SUMS attached to the same GitHub Release. The package includes a DSH bundle patch and built JavaScript; no Pi dependency is needed. Restart DSH after installation. Substitute your existing profile for `headless` if needed.

@lightjunction/dsh-recall README · Configuration：The default bundle config is `{}`: each tool uses the invoking agent's working directory. A host call without an agent requires an explicit `root`. To pin a host-local workspace, add an override in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: dsh-recall
  config:
    root: /absolute/local/project
```

@lightjunction/dsh-recall README · Configuration：The root must already exist. It is interpreted on the DSH host, using Node filesystem APIs. A remote DSH world or sandbox does not redirect these operations: only enable this plugin for a host-local project. This is not a remote-world adapter or a security sandbox.

@lightjunction/dsh-recall README · Tools and examples：Ask DSH: “Explicitly save this decision in recall: we chose SQLite for the local cache.” Later: “Search recall for sqlite cache.” Excerpts are untrusted quoted conversation data, not instructions. No session log is automatically searched, copied or summarized. Caller-supplied role/session attribution is not independently authenticated.

@lightjunction/dsh-recall README · Storage and limits：The store lives in `<workspace>/.dsh-recall/records.json`. The directory is created with mode 0700 and replacement files with mode 0600 (subject to filesystem/platform behavior). This is plaintext, not encryption: save only material appropriate to keep in this project, exclude `.dsh-recall/` from version control, and do not save secrets. This plugin intentionally does not edit your .gitignore.

@lightjunction/dsh-recall README · Storage and limits：At most 200 records / 4 MiB total, 50,000 UTF-8 bytes per excerpt, 200 characters per session ID, 500 per search query, and a search limit of 1–50. Traversal, symlink storage paths and nonregular files are rejected. Malformed stores fail closed; they are never silently reset. Search does not create storage. Records survive DSH/plugin restarts and are shared across agents using the same local root.

@lightjunction/dsh-recall README · Storage and limits：Writers acquire `.dsh-recall/write.lock` exclusively. Concurrent writers fail with “store busy” and can retry; accepted writes use a fsynced temporary file and atomic rename so readers see a complete old or new store. Temporary files and locks are removed on normal success/failure. A process crash can leave a lock/temp file: stop all writers, inspect/recover the store, then manually remove the stale lock/temp. There is no automatic stale-lock stealing or crash-time directory fsync guarantee. Cancellation is checked before commit and work is drained on dispose; a rename already committed is not rolled back by a later cancellation.

@lightjunction/dsh-recall README · Storage and limits：No Pi picker/menu, global Pi store migration, Markdown notes/templates, automatic session capture, DSH session-search replacement or automatic prompt injection is provided.

@lightjunction/dsh-recall README · Filesystem boundary and verification：Path checks reject ordinary symlink redirection; regular-file opens use no-follow flags and inode checks, bounded reads and cancellation. These checks are not a sandbox against a malicious process concurrently replacing ancestor directories; use a trusted local workspace. Linux/macOS-style filesystem semantics are the intended target; Windows behavior has not been verified.

```sh
npm run check
```

@lightjunction/dsh-recall README · Filesystem boundary and verification：The suite uses real Cordis, DSH ToolRuntime, agent-loop and an offline scripted model; it verifies actual model tool dispatch and results in the following model request, plus limits, revision/path checks, cancellation and unregistration. It requires no live model credentials. `check` includes TypeScript checks for source/tests, behavior tests and a build. See [UPSTREAM.md](UPSTREAM.md) for pinned source and migration differences and [NOTICE](NOTICE) for upstream MIT attribution.
